title: 2017 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI İLKBAHAR DÖNEMİ (2017-YDS İLKBAHAR DÖNEMİ) İNGİLİZCE

questions.questionText: 1. The ageing of population, also known as 'demographic ageing', is a term used to describe ---- in the age distribution of a population from the young towards people of older ages.
questions.explanation: Cümlede nüfusun yaşlanmasının, yaş dağılımında gençlerden yaşlılara doğru yaşanan 'değişimleri/kaymaları' (shifts) tanımlamak için kullanılan bir terim olduğu belirtilmektedir.
options: A) opportunities
B) regulations
C) shifts
D) assumptions
E) conflicts

questions.questionText: 2. Large collections of books are often unusable without careful attention to classification, so providing easy access to library materials using such labels as author, title, and subject, is essential for proper ---- of any library.
questions.explanation: Kütüphane materyallerine kolay erişim sağlamanın, herhangi bir kütüphanenin doğru 'kullanımı / faydalanılması' (utilisation) için gerekli (essential) olduğu ifade ediliyor.
options: A) violation
B) justification
C) abandonment
D) utilisation
E) elimination

questions.questionText: 3. During the investigation of a lethal or an easily transmitted disease, the necessary precautions must be taken to protect health staff, because they are ---- to catching the disease in question.
questions.explanation: Sağlık personelini korumak için önlemler alınmalıdır çünkü onlar söz konusu hastalığa yakalanmaya karşı 'savunmasızdır / yatkındır' (vulnerable).
options: A) committed
B) adaptable
C) entitled
D) vulnerable
E) accessible

questions.questionText: 4. IQ tests are often faulted for ignoring cultural or social biases, particularly with regard to schoolchildren, and critics claim they cannot ---- predict a person's future performance.
questions.explanation: Eleştirmenler, IQ testlerinin bir kişinin gelecekteki performansını 'doğru / isabetli bir şekilde' (accurately) tahmin edemeyeceğini iddia ederler.
options: A) initially
B) accurately
C) conventionally
D) narrowly
E) strictly

questions.questionText: 5. Parents who are responsive, non-authoritarian, and who manifest empathetic and caring behaviours can ---- the development of empathy in their children.
questions.explanation: Duyarlı, otoriter olmayan ve empatik davranışlar sergileyen ebeveynlerin çocuklarında empatinin gelişimini 'artırabileceği / geliştirebileceği' (enhance) anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) delay
B) acknowledge
C) relieve
D) enhance
E) surpass

questions.questionText: 6. World War II is an important turning point in that it ---- the beginning of the end of colonial empires.
questions.explanation: İkinci Dünya Savaşı'nın sömürge imparatorluklarının sonunun başlangıcını 'meydana getirmesi / yol açması' (brought about) bakımından önemli bir dönüm noktası olduğu ifade edilir.
options: A) made out
B) handed down
C) brought about
D) took over
E) put back

questions.questionText: 7. New research ---- that mother monkeys ---- to other females to help share the burden of raising increasingly dependent offspring.
questions.explanation: Yeni araştırmalar öne sürmüştür ki (has suggested), anne maymunlar yavru yetiştirme yükünü paylaşmak için diğer dişilere 'yönelirler' (turn - genel geçer bir doğru).
options: A) had suggested / were turning
B) suggests / had turned
C) suggested / have turned
D) has suggested / turn
E) will suggest / are turning

questions.questionText: 8. Patients with implants or electronic devices put inside their bodies ---- using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) because the machine's magnet ---- these objects within the body, causing damage.
questions.explanation: Vücutlarında implant olan hastalar MRI kullanılarak muayene 'edilemezler' (cannot be examined), çünkü makinenin mıknatısı bu nesneleri hareket 'ettirebilir' (might move) ve hasara neden olabilir.
options: A) should not be examined / must move
B) could not be examined / had to move
C) may not be examined / used to move
D) cannot be examined / might move
E) ought not to be examined / will have moved

questions.questionText: 9. In the age of steam, with new railroads ---- across Europe and the US, engineers began ---- even more applications for the steam engine.
questions.explanation: Avrupa ve ABD'ye 'yayılan' (spreading - active participle) yeni demiryolları ile birlikte mühendisler buhar motoru için daha fazla uygulama 'bulmaya' (to find) başladılar. 'Begin' fiilinden sonra 'to infinitive' kullanımı yaygındır.
options: A) to spread / finding
B) having spread / to have found
C) spreading / to find
D) to have spread / find
E) spread / having found

questions.questionText: 10. The psychological effects of a disaster can sometimes be more devastating than the physical ones, because the former may be experienced ---- a much larger population and be present ---- a longer period of time.
questions.explanation: Afetin psikolojik etkileri daha büyük bir nüfus 'tarafından' (by) tecrübe edilebilir ve daha uzun bir süre 'boyunca' (for a period of time) mevcut olabilir.
options: A) for / by
B) by / for
C) with / in
D) among / at
E) from / over

questions.questionText: 11. Starting ---- 800 AD, many agricultural communities emerged ---- the Mississippi and in other fertile river valleys in North America.
questions.explanation: MS 800 'civarında' (around) başlayarak, Mississippi nehri 'boyunca' (along) tarım topluluklarının ortaya çıktığı belirtilmiştir.
options: A) for / by
B) over / about
C) on / with
D) at / in
E) around / along

questions.questionText: 12. 70 percent of the Earth's surface is liquid, ---- water scarcity affects more than a billion people each year.
questions.explanation: Dünya yüzeyinin yüzde 70'inin sıvı (su) olmasına karşılık, su kıtlığının bir milyardan fazla insanı etkilemesi bir zıtlık oluşturur. Bu yüzden 'fakat / ancak' anlamındaki 'yet' kullanılır.
options: A) as if
B) yet
C) given that
D) instead
E) thus

questions.questionText: 13. Alphabetic writing systems are easy to learn and maximally efficient for transcribing any human language, ---- they are considered one of the major achievements of civilisation.
questions.explanation: Alfabetik yazı sistemlerinin öğrenmesi kolay ve verimli olması, onların medeniyetin en büyük başarılarından biri olarak kabul edilmesinin 'nedenidir'. Bu sebep-sonuç ilişkisini 'bu yüzden / bu nedenle' anlamındaki 'so' bağlar.
options: A) otherwise
B) but
C) so
D) whether
E) as

questions.questionText: 14. ---- historians cannot agree on when gold was first discovered, there is some evidence to suggest that the Egyptians were the first to mine it.
questions.explanation: Tarihçiler altının ilk ne zaman keşfedildiği konusunda hemfikir 'olamamalarına rağmen' (Even though), Mısırlıların onu ilk çıkaranlar olduğunu öne süren kanıtlar vardır (Zıtlık).
options: A) Now that
B) Just as
C) Even though
D) As long as
E) In case

questions.questionText: 15. Wheat, which has been a staple food for centuries, can turn out to be bad for some people -- because they are allergic to it ---- because they have an autoimmune disorder.
questions.explanation: Buğdayın bazı insanlar için kötü olabilmesi iki olası sebebe bağlanmıştır: 'ya' alerjileri olduğu için 'ya da' otoimmün bir bozuklukları olduğu için. Bu seçenek kalıbı 'either / or' (ya ... ya da) şeklindedir.
options: A) so / that
B) neither / nor
C) as / as
D) the more / the more
E) either / or

questions.questionText: 16. ---- its similarities with other Italian cities, it is important to emphasise that Venice's aquatic environment and associations with foreign lands via the sea endowed it with a uniqueness.
questions.explanation: Diğer İtalyan şehirleriyle olan benzerliklerine 'rağmen' (Despite), Venedik'in su ortamının ona bir benzersizlik kazandırdığını vurgulamak önemlidir.
options: A) Due to
B) By means of
C) In terms of
D) In case of
E) Despite

questions.questionText: 17. The Atacama Desert in South America is peppered with odd, cushion-like plants known as the llareta, a spongy cousin of parsley. Despite the harsh weather conditions that they have to (17)----, some of these plants are up to 3,000 years old.
questions.explanation: Zorlu hava koşullarına 'katlanmak / dayanmak' anlamında 'endure' fiili kullanılır.
options: A) endure
B) influence
C) avoid
D) trigger
E) improve

questions.questionText: 18. Though looking like a rock covered by small green plants without flowers, the plant has a tightly packed structure of branches, each adorned (18)---- clusters of tiny leaves.
questions.explanation: Bir şeyle süslenmiş/donatılmış anlamında 'adorned with' edat kalıbı kullanılır.
options: A) on
B) at
C) with
D) for
E) over

questions.questionText: 19. The resulting plant is so strong that you (19)---- on top of it very comfortably.
questions.explanation: Bitki o kadar güçlüdür ki üzerinde çok rahat bir şekilde 'durabilirsiniz' (can stand - genel yetenek/olasılık).
options: A) had better stand
B) may have stood
C) can stand
D) used to stand
E) must stand

questions.questionText: 20. (20)----, this hardiness comes at a price: the plants are thought to grow just 1.5 cm a year.
questions.explanation: Önceki cümlede bitkinin ne kadar güçlü olduğundan bahsedilmiş, bu cümlede ise bu dayanıklılığın bir bedeli olduğu (yavaş büyümesi) söylenmiştir. Bu zıtlığı 'Ancak' (However) bağlacı sağlar.
options: A) For instance
B) However
C) Therefore
D) Similarly
E) Otherwise

questions.questionText: 21. According to Catherine Kleier, a researcher from Regis University, Colorado, the llareta became very strong (21)---- a combination of environmental factors (cold at night and hot in the day) and it is compact to trap heat.
questions.explanation: Bitkinin çok güçlü hale gelmesi çevresel faktörlerin bir kombinasyonu 'yüzünden / sayesinde' (because of) gerçekleşmiştir.
options: A) rather than
B) in addition to
C) contrary to
D) except for
E) because of

questions.questionText: 22. Both Mars and Venus have been objects of scientific and popular speculation since at least the beginning of the 20th century, and since the 1960s spacefaring nations have been sending robotic probes to explore these two planets. (22)----, Mars has drawn far more attention.
questions.explanation: Her iki gezegen de keşfedilmek için araçlar gönderilen hedefler olsa da, 'Buna rağmen / Yine de' (Nevertheless) Mars çok daha fazla ilgi çekmiştir.
options: A) Accordingly
B) Nevertheless
C) Furthermore
D) That is
E) At first

questions.questionText: 23. Since 2002 no fewer than two Mars probes have been actively gathering data during any given year. There were actually seven used in 2015 alone. This is (23)---- because Mars is far more hospitable than Venus...
questions.explanation: Bunun nedeni 'başlıca / temel olarak' (primarily) Mars'ın Venüs'ten çok daha misafirperver olmasıdır.
options: A) accidentally
B) excessively
C) ultimately
D) randomly
E) primarily

questions.questionText: 24. We have direct evidence that water once flowed and pooled (24)---- Mars.
questions.explanation: Mars gezegeninin 'üzerinde / yüzeyinde' anlamında 'on Mars' kullanılır.
options: A) from
B) by
C) toward
D) on
E) into

questions.questionText: 25. So, it can be assumed that life once existed there and (25)---- at present.
questions.explanation: Geçmişte yaşamın var olduğu ve şu anda da 'var olabileceği' (may exist) varsayılabilir (olasılık).
options: A) may exist
B) must have existed
C) could have existed
D) would have existed
E) used to exist

questions.questionText: 26. Venus is far more Earth-like than Mars in its size, composition and surface gravity, but (26)---- its harsh environment, it could never host life.
questions.explanation: Venüs boyut olarak Dünya'ya daha çok benzese de, zorlu çevresi 'nedeniyle / yüzünden' (due to) asla hayata ev sahipliği yapamaz.
options: A) due to
B) instead of
C) in comparison to
D) unlike
E) such as

questions.questionText: 27. Although buying energy-saving light bulbs and riding your bike to work are the correct choices to save the planet, ----.
questions.explanation: Enerji tasarruflu ampuller almak veya işe bisikletle gitmek gezegeni kurtarmak için doğru seçimler 'olmasına rağmen' (Although), bu küçük adımların 'sorunu tamamen ortadan kaldıracağını hayal edemeyiz' şeklindeki zıtlık doğru tamamlamadır.
options: A) we cannot imagine these are going to eradicate the problem
B) we could save the world by relying on renewable energy sources
C) that is what we should already be doing to take action
D) small acts of consumption can be politically activating
E) it seems that people are in search for a complete solution

questions.questionText: 28. Since we now generate more data every year than the entire planet did up until 2003, ----.
questions.explanation: Artık her yıl 2003'e kadar olan tüm gezegenin ürettiğinden daha fazla veri ürettiğimiz 'için' (Since), 'bu verileri depolama ve muhafaza etme şeklimiz değişmek zorundadır' (sebep-sonuç).
options: A) libraries continue to keep records of knowledge in the form of books
B) it is inconceivable to have effective database management systems
C) the way we store and preserve that data has to change
D) it is not possible for data stored on digital platforms to vanish
E) humanity's cumulative knowledge will not disappear if stored digitally

questions.questionText: 29. Even though William Hamilton was not the first person to come up with the idea for a jet boat, ----.
questions.explanation: William Hamilton jet tekne fikrini ortaya atan ilk kişi 'olmamasına rağmen' (Even though), 'geleneksel tekne dünyasında devrim yaratmakla itibar görmüştür / ona atfedilmiştir' zıtlığı cümleyi tamamlar.
options: A) Greek scholar Archimedes had the concept of a jet boat when he devised his water screw
B) the maneuverability of the jet boat has long made its design highly marketable
C) he has been credited with revolutionising the conventional world of boating
D) Italian inventor Secondo Campani had devised a remarkably similar jet-powered boat
E) he lived in New Zealand, where his boat was able to power quickly through shallow waters

questions.questionText: 30. Although our bones stop growing in length in our late teens, ----
questions.explanation: Kemiklerimiz ergenlik çağının sonlarında uzunluk olarak büyümeyi durdursa 'da' (Although), 'yetişkinlik dönemi boyunca onları güçlü ve sağlıklı tutmak için gerekli besinleri almamız çok önemlidir'.
options: A) there is some evidence that too little or too much protein can reduce bone strength
B) it is crucial that we get necessary nutrients to keep them strong and healthy right through adulthood
C) from the first few weeks after pregnancy, our bones grow and develop healthy and strong bone tissues
D) sources of dairy and non-dairy calcium can help fight even hereditary bone conditions
E) low bone density disease is largely preventable at any age with the right diet and lifestyle

questions.questionText: 31. Just as an accomplished writer must help us visualise events rather than plainly tell them, ----.
questions.explanation: Başarılı bir yazarın olayları düz bir şekilde anlatmak yerine gözümüzde canlandırmamıza yardımcı olması 'gerektiği gibi' (Just as), 'iyi bir hikaye anlatıcısının da sadece bir betimleme değil bir deneyim sunması beklenir' benzerliği kurulmuştur.
options: A) storytellers are a significant voice of culture, and their storytelling takes many forms
B) a good storyteller is expected to provide not just a description but an experience
C) some people make a living as professional storytellers
D) the intellectual and emotional impacts of effective storytellers are undeniable
E) the words of storytellers may capture the minds and feelings of listeners

questions.questionText: 32. The huge improvement in levels of readership in the 1960s largely coincided with the arrival of television, ----
questions.explanation: 1960'larda okuyucu sayısındaki devasa iyileşme büyük ölçüde televizyonun gelişiyle aynı zamana denk geldi, 'bu yüzden televizyonun okumayı öldüreceğine dair ilk beklenti doğru değildi' cümlesi anlamca uygun sonucu verir.
options: A) but there was a dramatic increase in the number of people who spent their time watching TV
B) thus people began to pay more attention to the best-selling books, especially detective novels
C) because the presence of televisions within reach of almost everyone fostered reading
D) so the initial expectation that TV would kill off reading was not correct
E) when the amount of time people spent on reading dropped significantly

questions.questionText: 33. In 19th-century Europe, women and children were used extensively in factories ----.
questions.explanation: 19. yüzyıl Avrupa'sında fabrikalarda kadınların ve çocukların yaygın olarak kullanılmasının nedeni (since), 'onların daha düşük ücretlerle çalışması ve isteksiz erkek işgücünü telafi etmesiydi'.
options: A) although only about 20 percent of workers were employed in factories in 1850
B) when they became aware of the negative effects of factory work on their health
C) since they worked for lower wages and compensated for reluctant male labour
D) as the factory system fundamentally altered the nature of work in European society
E) provided that safety codes were implemented to protect them from dangerous machines

questions.questionText: 34. When employees feel that their bosses show their gratitude and make them feel valued, ----
questions.explanation: Çalışanlar, patronlarının minnettarlıklarını gösterdiğini ve kendilerini değerli hissettirdiğini hissettiklerinde (When), 'patronlarının hatalarına karşı daha affedici olma eğilimindedirler' (tend to be more forgiving...).
options: A) they tend to be more forgiving of their bosses' mistakes
B) their conflicts with their managers are increased to resolve
C) until they are provided with little practical direction from their bosses
D) even if they engage in new, interesting activities together with their colleagues
E) while supporting each other's attempts to improve relationships is crucial

questions.questionText: 35. It is more energy efficient for small birds to move by hopping ----.
questions.explanation: Küçük kuşlar için zıplayarak hareket etmek enerji açısından daha verimlidir, 'çünkü (because of the fact that) hafif vücutları havaya kolayca seker/zıplar'.
options: A) but they cover much more distance in a single hop than with a step with their short legs
B) since birds spending most of their time in trees jump from branch to branch
C) so there is an extra load on the joints of heavier birds leaving one leg on the ground all the time
D) as almost all birds are capable of both hopping and walking at the same time
E) because of the fact that their light bodies easily bounce into the air

questions.questionText: 36. Many of us tend to overlook our mental well-being ----.
questions.explanation: Birçoğumuz, 'ciddi bir sorun ortaya çıkana ve hayatımızdaki dengeyi kaybedene KADAR' (until) zihinsel sağlığımızı göz ardı etme eğilimindeyizdir.
options: A) so that mental health disorders can be correctly diagnosed through specialised tests
B) until a serious problem arises and we lose balance in our lives
C) because we should try to keep our minds as active as our physical health
D) now that we enjoy our life without experiencing any major setbacks
E) just as cognitive decline might be a sign of a severe psychological problem

questions.questionText: 37. The arrival of the domestic horse in West Africa transformed warfare there and turned the area into a set of kingdoms dependent on the force of cavalry.
questions.explanation: Özne: The arrival of the domestic horse in West Africa (Evcil atların Batı Afrika'ya ulaşması), Yüklem 1: transformed warfare there (oradaki savaş anlayışını değiştirdi) Yüklem 2: and turned the area into a set of kingdoms... (ve bölgeyi atlı asker gücüne dayalı bir dizi krallığa dönüştürdü). En doğru çeviri C şıkkıdır.
options: A) Batı Afrika'nın atlı asker gücüne bağlı bir dizi krallığa dönüşmesinin nedeni, evcil atların bölgeye gelişi ve oradaki savaş anlayışını değiştirmesidir.
B) Batı Afrika'daki savaş anlayışı evcil atların gelişiyle değişti ve bölge atlı asker gücüne dayalı bir dizi krallığa dönüştü.
C) Evcil atların Batı Afrika'ya ulaşması oradaki savaş anlayışını değiştirdi ve bölgeyi atlı asker gücüne dayalı bir dizi krallığa dönüştürdü.
D) Evcil atların bölgeye ulaşmasıyla savaş anlayışında değişiklikler yaşayan Batı Afrika, atlı asker gücüne dayalı bir dizi krallık haline geldi.
E) Evcil atların Batı Afrika'ya ulaşması oradaki savaş anlayışını değiştirerek bölgenin atlı asker gücüne dayalı bir dizi krallığa dönüşmesine neden oldu.

questions.questionText: 38. A study carried out at Weill Cornell Medical College has found out how the brain switches between waking and the unconscious, which is promising for rousing people from an unconscious state.
questions.explanation: 'Weill Cornell Tıp Fakültesi'nde yapılan bir çalışma... ortaya çıkarmıştır' (A study carried out at... has found out) ana cümlesidir. Relative clause 'which is promising for...' kısmı 'ki bu insanları bilinçsiz bir durumdan uyandırma konusunda ümit vericidir' şeklinde ayrılır. E seçeneği bu yapıyı en doğru şekliyle yansıtır.
options: A) Weill Cornell Tıp Fakültesi'nde yapılan ve beynin uyanma ve bilinçaltı arasında nasıl geçiş yaptığını ortaya çıkaran çalışma, insanları bilinçsiz bir durumdan uyandırma konusunda ümit vericidir.

B) Weill Cornell Tıp Fakültesi'nde yapılan bir çalışma, beynin uyanma ve bilinçaltı arasında nasıl geçiş yaptığını ortaya çıkardığı için insanları bilinçsiz bir durumdan uyandırma konusunda ümit vadediyor.

C) Weill Cornell Tıp Fakültesi'nde, beynin uyanma ve bilinçaltı arasında nasıl geçiş yaptığını ortaya çıkarma ve insanları bilinçsiz bir durumdan uyandırma konusunda ümit vadeden bir çalışma yapılmıştır.

D) Beynin uyanma ve bilinçaltı arasında nasıl geçiş yaptığını ortaya çıkaran ve insanları bilinçsiz bir durumdan uyandırma konusunda ümit vadeden bir çalışma, Weill Cornell Tıp Fakültesi'nde yapılmıştır.

E) Weill Cornell Tıp Fakültesi'nde yapılan bir çalışma, beynin uyanma ve bilinçaltı arasında nasıl geçiş yaptığını ortaya çıkarmıştır, ki bu insanları bilinçsiz bir durumdan uyandırma konusunda ümit vericidir.

questions.questionText: 39. Widely regarded as Australia's capital of culture, Melbourne is a vibrant city with various surprises around every corner.
questions.explanation: Kısaltma yancümlesi 'Widely regarded as Australia's capital of culture' (Çoğunlukla Avustralya'nın kültür başkenti olarak kabul edilen), ana cümlenin öznesi 'Melbourne', yüklemi ise 'is a vibrant city with various surprises around every corner' (her köşesinde çeşitli sürprizler barındıran canlı bir kenttir).
options: A) Çoğunlukla Avustralya'nın kültür başkenti olarak kabul edilen Melbourne, her köşesinde çeşitli sürprizler barındıran canlı bir kenttir.
B) Melbourne'ün çoğunlukla Avustralya'nın kültür başkenti olarak kabul edilmesinin sebebi, bu canlı şehrin her köşesinde çeşitli sürprizler barındırıyor olmasıdır.
C) Çoğunlukla Avustralya'nın kültür başkenti olarak kabul edilen Melbourne, çok çeşitli sürprizleri her köşesinde barındıran canlı bir şehirdir.
D) Çoğunlukla Avustralya'nın kültür başkenti kabul edilen canlı bir şehir olan Melbourne, her köşesinde çeşitli sürprizler barındırır.
E) Melbourne, çoğunlukla Avustralya'nın kültür başkenti olarak kabul edilmesine rağmen her köşesinde çeşitli sürprizler barındıran canlı bir şehirdir.

questions.questionText: 40. Öğretmenler, öğretim yöntemi seçerken, öğrencilerinin özellikleri ve hâlihazırdaki kaynakların yanı sıra kendi yeterliliklerini ve bilgilerini de göz önünde bulundurmalıdırlar.
questions.explanation: 'Öğretmenler ... öğretim yöntemi seçerken' (When choosing a teaching method, teachers), 'göz önünde bulundurmalıdırlar' (should take ... into account), '...yanı sıra' (along with/as well as). C şıkkı kelime dizilimi ve anlam olarak en iyi çeviridir.
options: A) What teachers need to do when choosing a teaching method is to take their own capabilities and knowledge into account as well as their students' characteristics and the resources available.
B) When they follow a teaching method, teachers are expected to consider their own capabilities and knowledge together with their students' characteristics and the resources available.
C) When choosing a teaching method, teachers should take their own capabilities and knowledge into account along with their students' characteristics and the resources available.
D) When implementing a teaching method, teachers should consider not only their students' characteristics and the resources available but also their own capabilities and knowledge.
E) Their own capabilities and knowledge besides their students' characteristics and the resources available should be taken into account by teachers when choosing a teaching method.

questions.questionText: 41. Köpek balıklarının sayısı önemli ölçüde azalıyor ve bu yırtıcı balıklar yavaş geliştikleri ve nadiren üredikleri için nüfuslarının hızlı bir şekilde artması olası görünmüyor.
questions.explanation: İlk cümle 'The number of sharks is falling substantially' (Köpek balıklarının sayısı önemli ölçüde azalıyor). İkinci kısım 've ... için ... olası görünmüyor' şeklindedir (and as these predatory fish slowly mature and rarely reproduce, it seems unlikely that...).
options: A) Given that the number of sharks is falling drastically as these predatory fish slowly mature and seldom reproduce, there is no likelihood that their population will increase quickly.
B) Because sharks slowly mature and rarely reproduce, their number is falling greatly, and so the population of these predatory fish seems unlikely to increase rapidly.
C) The number of sharks is falling substantially, and as these predatory fish slowly mature and rarely reproduce, it seems unlikely that their population will increase quickly.
D) It seems unlikely that shark population will increase quickly since these predatory fish, whose number is falling considerably, slowly mature and seldom reproduce.
E) The number of sharks is falling substantially, and because these predatory fish slowly mature and rarely reproduce, it is highly unlikely that there will be a rapid increase in their population.

questions.questionText: 42. Dünya üzerinde yaşam başladığından bu yana yüz milyonlarca bitki ve hayvan türünün nesli tükendi ve insanlar son 300 yıldır doğal yaşam alanlarını tahrip ederek yok olma sürecini büyük ölçüde hızlandırdı.
questions.explanation: İlk kısım 'Hundreds of millions of species of plants and animals have become extinct since life began on Earth' (Dünya üzerinde yaşam başladığından bu yana yüz milyonlarca bitki ve hayvan türünün nesli tükendi). İkinci kısım 've insanlar son 300 yıldır ... tahrip ederek ... hızlandırdı' (and over the past 300 years people have dramatically speeded up the extinction process by destroying habitats).
options: A) Since life began on Earth, hundreds of millions of species of plants and animals have been threatened with extinction, and over the past 300 years the extinction process has substantially accelerated due to habitat destruction caused by people.

B) Hundreds of millions of species of plants and animals have become extinct since life began on Earth, and over the past 300 years people have been damaging habitats, thus significantly speeding up the extinction process.

C) Hundreds of millions of species of plants and animals have become extinct since life began on Earth, and over the past 300 years people have dramatically speeded up the extinction process by destroying habitats.

D) Since life began on Earth, hundreds of millions of species of plants and animals have become extinct, and habitats have been damaged by people, which has substantially accelerated the extinction process for the past 300 years.

E) There are hundreds of millions of species of plants and animals that have faced extinction since life began on Earth, and people who are destroying habitats have dramatically speeded up the extinction process for the past 300 years.

questions.questionText: 43. It can be understood from the passage that the airbags were ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Hetrick'in sıkıştırılmış hava torpidosunun 'göz açıp kapayıncaya kadar' (quicker than a blink of an eye) hızla fırlamasını hatırladığı ve hava yastıklarının çarpışma anında 'hızla şişmesi' (inflate rapidly) fikrini önerdiği belirtiliyor. Yani acil koruma sağlamak için çok hızlı çalışacak şekilde tasarlandıkları (designed to work very fast to provide immediate protection) anlaşılmaktadır.
options: A) widely accepted when they were first introduced in 1952
B) invented with the fundamental aim of making cars look more attractive
C) manufactured largely in order to improve automobile marketing and increase the sales
D) invented by a US engineer while he was launching the canvas cover into the air
E) designed to work very fast to provide immediate protection for people

questions.questionText: 44. It is pointed out in the passage that in the 1950s, car manufacturers ----.
questions.explanation: Parçada 1950'lerde araba üreticilerinin 'güvenlikten çok stile ilgi duyduğu' ('car manufacturers in the 1950s were more interested in style than safety') açıkça belirtilmektedir.
options: A) developed a compressed mechanism which inflated airbags swiftly
B) benefitted from optional airbags to raise the safety awareness among the customers
C) paid more attention to the physical appearance of cars rather than their safety
D) started to produce standard airbags in line with the innovations in airbag technology
E) were highly concerned with safety requirements imposed on automobile industry

questions.questionText: 45. Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
questions.explanation: Parçanın sonunda hava yastıklarının ölüm ve yaralanmaları önlemede her zaman yeterli olmadığı, emniyet kemeri takılması gerektiği ve ayrıca 'arabaların, çarpışmalardaki enerjiyi emebilecek yumuşak malzemeden yapılmış ön panellere ve direksiyon kolonlarına sahip olması gerektiği' (must have dashboards... that can absorb energy during impact) vurgulanmıştır.
options: A) The injuries and deaths in car accidents can be completely prevented with airbags.
B) As soon as Hetrick patented the airbag, it became obligatory for manufacturers to equip cars with airbags.
C) The dashboards and steering columns of automobiles should be designed elaborately to increase the efficiency of airbags.
D) Travellers are expected to fasten their seat belts which enable the airbags to inflate more quickly.
E) Automobile designs are required to manipulate the energy in a crash in order to save people's lives.

questions.questionText: 46. Which could be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Metin temel olarak hava yastığının bir ilham anından doğup patenti alınmasına, zamanla teknolojisinin gelişmesine ve standart hale gelmesine odaklanmaktadır. Dolayısıyla 'The Advance of Airbag Technology' (Hava Yastığı Teknolojisinin Gelişimi) en uygun başlıktır.
options: A) Advances in the Automobile Industry
B) An Alternative Way to Save Life
C) Airbags as a Safety Regulation
D) How to Prevent Car Accidents with Airbags
E) The Advance of Airbag Technology

questions.questionText: 47. It is pointed out in the passage that the change in the vocalisation of the Dutch chimps ----.
questions.explanation: Felemenk (Hollandalı) şempanzelerin seslerindeki (vocalisation) değişimin 'yeni komşularına uyum sağlamak için' (to fit in with new neighbours) meydana geldiği metinde açıkça belirtilmiştir.
options: A) was essential for the Dutch chimps to communicate with the Scottish apes
B) proved that chimpanzees possess a uniquely human language ability
C) happened as a result of their changing emotional responses
D) helped them to adapt to their new environment / fit in with new neighbours
E) made the Scottish apes change their pitch to match the newcomers

questions.questionText: 48. Which of the following makes chimpanzees resemble us?
questions.explanation: Tıpkı bizim gibi ('like us'), şempanzelerin de yeni komşularına uyum sağlamak için yabancı bir dil (veya yeni bir ses frekansı) öğrenebildikleri ('learn foreign language to fit in with new neighbours') ifade ediliyor.
options: A) Their language learning ability to get involved in a foreign environment
B) The fixed words that they use to refer to objects
C) The association between their words and emotional outbursts
D) Their inability to control their loud calls
E) Their emotional responses to foreign languages

questions.questionText: 49. What was the general assumption about the animals' use of language?
questions.explanation: Metinde genel varsayımın (general assumption) hayvanların çıkardıkları sesler üzerinde kontrol sahibi olmadıkları ('animals do not have control over the sounds they make') olduğu belirtiliyor.
options: A) They use a primitive form of language to interact with us.
B) They have control over the tones of their calls.
C) Their voices match closely with humans in similar environments.
D) They have no conscious control over the sounds they produce.
E) Their emotional outbursts restrict their language capabilities.

questions.questionText: 50. One can understand from the passage that unlike what is commonly accepted, ----.
questions.explanation: Yaygın olarak kabul edilenin (hayvanların sesleri üzerinde kontrolü olmaması) aksine, Slocombe'un araştırması şempanzelerin çıkardıkları sesleri bilinçli olarak (yeni bir gruba uymak için) değiştirebildiklerini ('chimps can consciously change the sounds they produce') göstermiştir.
options: A) chimp words for objects do not vary
B) chimps can consciously change the sounds they produce
C) chimp call structure includes involuntary outbursts
D) chimps are not able to produce sounds that have meanings
E) chimp words for objects are linked to emotional outbursts

questions.questionText: 51. It is stated in the passage that Manby's fire extinguisher ----.
questions.explanation: Manby'nin taşınabilir bir yangın söndürücü icat etmesi, binaların üst katlarındaki yangınlara ulaşmakta zorlanan itfaiyecileri görmesinden (inspired to invent a portable fire extinguisher after witnessing firemen's inability to fight fires on the top floors...) ilham almıştır.
options: A) was initially developed to rescue people from shipwrecks
B) was much less effective than the device designed by Ambrose Godfrey
C) was inspired by the firemen who wanted to reach the top floors of buildings
D) was appropriate for the use of several pressurising agents to spread the potassium carbonate
E) took more time to activate when compared to Godfrey's device

questions.questionText: 52. What is the main reason why Manby's invention in 1818 was more efficient?
questions.explanation: Sistemin taşınabilir olması sayesinde itfaiyecilerin başka türlü ulaşılamayacak alanlara ulaşmasını sağladığı ('allowing firemen to reach otherwise inaccessible areas') metinde açıkça veriliyor.
options: A) It could use various pressurising agents to scatter the extinguishing liquid.
B) It enabled firemen to deal with fires in places that they had previously been unable to reach.
C) It proved its convenience when it helped to extinguish a fire in London in 1729.
D) It contained compressed air to spread potassium carbonate over a large area.
E) It was widely used to rescue people from shipwrecks.

questions.questionText: 53. It can be inferred from the passage that Manby ----.
questions.explanation: Godfrey'in cihazı sıvıyı dağıtmak için barut (gunpowder) kullanırken, Manby'nin potasyum karbonatı dağıtmak için cihazında 'sıkıştırılmış hava' (compressed air) kullandığı ifade ediliyor.
options: A) relied heavily on Godfrey's prototype to design his own.
B) successfully eliminated the need for modern extinguishers.
C) was the first to realize that water is the best extinguishing agent.
D) used compressed air to propel the liquid instead of gunpowder.
E) received significant help from firemen to finalize his invention.

questions.questionText: 54. What is the primary purpose of the author?
questions.explanation: Yazarın temel amacı, Godfrey'den başlayarak Manby'nin yeniliklerine (taşınabilirlik ve sıkıştırılmış hava kullanımı) ve bunun modern modellere nasıl ilham verdiğine kadar yangın söndürücünün gelişimini (development of the fire extinguisher) okuyucuya aktarmaktır.
options: A) To give examples of the pressurising agents used in fire extinguishers
B) To make a comparison between Manby's fire extinguisher and Godfrey's device
C) To inform the reader about the development of the fire extinguisher
D) To put emphasis on portable fire extinguishers that help firemen to reach inaccessible areas
E) To describe the benefits and limitations of Manby's fire extinguisher

questions.questionText: 55. It is clearly stated in the passage that youthful blood ----.
questions.explanation: Stanford Üniversitesi araştırması, genç farelerin kanındaki bir şeyin yaşlı farelerdeki zihinsel yetenekleri 'eski haline getirme / onarma kapasitesi' (ability to restore mental capabilities) olduğunu bulmuştur. Bu da beynin yaşlanmasını tersine çevirme kapasitesini ifade eder.
options: A) has the capacity to reverse the ageing of the brain in mice
B) decreases the spatial memory capabilities in younger mice
C) increases the deterioration of the hippocampus in old mice
D) was unable to show improvements in the control group
E) is being currently used to treat Alzheimer's disease

questions.questionText: 56. A control group is a group in an experiment where the factor being tested is not applied so that it can be compared against another group where the factor is applied. According to this definition, which of the following is referred to with the expression 'the control group' that is underlined in the passage?
questions.explanation: Metinde genç kanı alan farelerde hipokampusta yeni bağlantılar oluştuğu, ancak 'diğer yaşlı farelerin kanı enjekte edilen eski farelerde' (Old mice injected with the blood of other old mice) bu gelişmenin olmadığı ('not seen in the control group') ifade ediliyor. Yani kontrol grubu eski kan enjekte edilen yaşlı farelerdir.
options: A) The old mice injected with the blood of young mice
B) The old mice injected with the blood of other old mice
C) The young mice injected with the blood of old mice
D) The young mice injected with the blood of other young mice
E) The old mice whose spatial memory is tested without any injections

questions.questionText: 57. It can be inferred from the passage that the hippocampus ----.
questions.explanation: Hipokampusun hafızada, özellikle 'mekansal kalıpları (nesnelerin boyutu ve yeri vb.) tanıma ve hatırlamada büyük rol oynadığı' (recognising and recalling spatial patterns) ifade ediliyor.
options: A) weakens more quickly in mice than in humans
B) will perform much better in old people if they receive blood from young ones
C) provides help in remembering the place and size of things
D) gets better at remembering as one gets older and his or her spatial awareness develops
E) stops functioning when someone develops such conditions as Alzheimer's disease

questions.questionText: 58. Which could be the best title for this passage?
questions.explanation: Metin, genç farelerden alınan kanın yaşlı farelerin mekansal hafızasını nasıl geliştirdiğini ve hipokampusu nasıl yenilediğini anlattığı için 'Daha İyi Hafızalar İçin Farelere Bakmak' (Looking to Mice for Better Memories) uygun bir başlıktır.
options: A) How to Take Care of Your Hippocampus
B) The Important Role of the Hippocampus
C) How Mice's Spatial Memory Functions
D) Looking to Mice for Better Memories
E) Saying Goodbye to Mental Disorders

questions.questionText: 59. It is stated in the passage that Robert Peary ----.
questions.explanation: Yıllarca övgü toplayan Robert Peary'nin Kuzey Kutbu'na ilk ulaşan kaşif olarak kabul edilmesine rağmen, 'o dönemde bile iddiasının tartışıldığı ve kesin bir kanıt sunamadığı' ('claim was disputed... neither of them could provide definitive proof') anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) was worried that people would question his status as the first explorer to reach the North Pole
B) had been accepted for years as the first explorer to reach the North Pole although he did not offer conclusive evidence about his expedition
C) did not want to present the details of his expedition to the independent commission after he learned that Dr Cook was rejected
D) requested the US National Geographic Society to analyse the photographs and data he gathered during his expedition to prove his claim
E) was not viewed as the first person to reach the North Pole since Dr Cook was thought to have arrived there earlier

questions.questionText: 60. Which of the following was declared by the US National Geographic Society in 1989?
questions.explanation: 1989'da US National Geographic Derneği, Peary'nin fotoğrafları ve kayıtlarının analizinin, onun seferinin 'gerçek kutba sekiz kilometre kadar yaklaştığıyla' ('getting within eight kilometres of the true pole') tutarlı olduğunu duyurdu.
options: A) Dr Cook's expedition was proven to have taken place a year before Peary's journey.
B) Peary's photographs and records were as controversial and unconvincing as those of Dr Cook.
C) Dr Cook's claim was suspicious since he did not reveal clear evidence relating to his travel to the North Pole.
D) The North Pole was reached multiple times by airborne and submarine expeditions after Peary and Dr Cook.
E) Robert Peary's records and photographs proved that he got very close to the true pole.

questions.questionText: 61. Why did the success of Ralph Plaisted and his companions' expedition to the North Pole in 1968 cause a surprise?
questions.explanation: Şaşırtıcı bir şekilde ('Surprisingly'), yüzey üzerinden Kuzey Kutbu'na ulaşan 'ilk tartışmasız' (first undisputed) keşif gezisinin 1968'e kadar hedefine ulaşamaması, bu tarihteki seferin kabul gören tek sefer olması nedeniyledir.
options: A) They succeeded in arriving at the North Pole using snowmobiles.
B) No one was expecting that a group of people could walk as far as the North Pole.
C) At that time, their expedition was the only one that was recognised to be true.
D) Herbert was claimed to have arrived at the North Pole before them on foot.
E) They provided more accurate data than earlier airborne and submarine expeditions did.

questions.questionText: 62. Which of the following can be concluded from the passage?
questions.explanation: Peary, Cook, Plaisted ve Herbert gibi birçok kaşifin Kuzey Kutbu'na ulaşma iddiasında bulunması ve bunun için yarışması, Kuzey Kutbuna ulaşmanın 'maceracılar için itibar getiren büyük bir hedef' olduğunu (an objective to be achieved for adventurers, which brings reputation to them) kanıtlar.
options: A) All of the expeditions to the North Pole were questioned until Herbert reached the pole on foot.
B) Even though Peary has been accepted as the first explorer to reach the North Pole, it was actually Dr Cook who attained the goal.
C) The adventurers were strongly supported by the US National Geographic Society during their trip to the North Pole.
D) Reaching the North Pole has been an objective to be achieved for adventurers, which brings reputation to them.
E) April is the best time for embarking on an expedition to the North Pole, as both Peary and Herbert did.

questions.questionText: 63. Christopher: I like the idea of Formula E, which is a new racing championship for single-seater cars powered only by electricity. Albert: ---- Christopher: Well, it is a platform for research to improve electric powerstations and charging systems to make electric cars more feasible and hopefully more popular. Albert: I see, this seems to be a good way to encourage the use of energy-efficient and sustainable transportation.
questions.explanation: Christopher bunun elektrikli araç sistemlerini geliştirmek için bir araştırma platformu (platform for research) olduğunu söylüyor. O zaman Albert, 'Formula 1 gibi başka yarışlar varken buna neden ihtiyacımız var?' (Why do we need this when there are other races...) şeklinde bir soru sormalıdır.
options: A) Why do we need this when there are other races such as Formula 1?
B) What kind of power do Formula E race cars use?
C) How do they plan to attract sponsors for such an event?
D) Where do they plan to have these races?
E) How frequently will the Formula E races be held?

questions.questionText: 64. Reporter: Antibiotic resistance is on the rise, and we are potentially facing a time when standard antibiotics simply won't work anymore. Why is antibiotic resistance becoming more widespread? Chemist: One reason could be that a type of bacteria has developed molecular mechanisms that actually make an antibiotic drug ineffective. Reporter: Why is the increase in bacterial resistance considered a threatening issue? Chemist: ---- Reporter: This sounds horrible!
questions.explanation: Kimyager bu artışın neden 'tehditkar bir mesele' olduğunu açıklamalıdır. D şıkkında 'Yeni ilaçlar geliştirilmezse, 2050 yılına kadar dirençli bakterilerden ölümler kanserden ölümleri bile aşabilir' (death from antimicrobial resistant bacteria could actually even surpass death from cancer) demesi muhabirin 'Bu kulağa korkunç geliyor!' tepkisini haklı çıkarır.
options: A) The misuse of antibiotics has certainly contributed to the resistance phenomena. A lot of antibiotics are used in farming, which is practised without complete control.
B) We should prevent them from producing toxins that lead to illness rather than kill them. That kind of intervention can reduce the chances that the bacteria will develop resistance.
C) Whenever any pressure is put on bacteria, it will resist. If such pressure is not created, there will be no evolutionary pressure for the bacteria to develop resistance.
D) If new drugs are not developed against these resistant bacteria, by the year 2050, death from antimicrobial resistant bacteria could actually even surpass death from cancer.
E) I'm encouraged by the fact that there are more than 200 different bacteria species that live in our guts, and the majority of them are actually beneficial to us.

questions.questionText: 65. Daisy: I want to take up gardening as a hobby and grow vegetables, but I don't have a garden to plant them in. Caroline: ---- Daisy: But they may not grow successfully if they don't get a sufficient amount of sunlight. Caroline: You can grow some vegetables without any sun at all. For example, lettuce and parsley will grow beautifully under artificial light.
questions.explanation: Daisy bahçesi olmadığını söylüyor. Caroline bir tavsiyede bulunuyor ve Daisy 'Ama yeterli güneş ışığı almazlarsa başarılı büyümeyebilirler' diyor. Bu yüzden Caroline'in kapalı alanlardan (çatı, bodrum, balkon) bahsetmesi mantıklıdır: 'Hiç iç mekan bahçeciliğini duydun mu? Çatı katını, bodrumu veya balkonu kullanabilirsin.' (C şıkkı).
options: A) It's not only the space you should take into account, but sunlight is also important when growing vegetables.
B) Vegetables need to be watered very frequently, and they tend to grow more nicely in sunny areas.
C) Have you ever heard about indoor gardening? You can use your attic, basement, or balcony to grow vegetables.
D) Near a bright window that takes sunlight at high intensity, you can grow cherry tomatoes and cucumbers.
E) I suggest you install a greenhouse. Greenhouses are the most convenient places to grow vegetables, and they vary vastly in size and price.

questions.questionText: 66. Defne: I read that remembering the past in a positive way could make us happy in times of crisis. Beren: ---- Defne: Can you give me an example? Beren: During a divorce, I'm not sure that it's helpful for a person to focus on all the good times in the marriage. They're likely to experience an even greater sense of loss.
questions.explanation: Beren, boşanma sırasında iyi günleri hatırlamanın faydalı olmayacağını ve kayıp hissini artıracağını söylüyor. Bu durumda Beren Defne'nin 'geçmişi olumlu hatırlamak bizi mutlu eder' fikrine katılmamalıdır. C şıkkı 'Katılmıyorum. Depresyondayken daha iyi zamanları hatırlamak, kişinin sorunlarını çözmekten ziyade kötüleştirecektir' (I don't agree. Recalling better times when a person is depressed will worsen their problems...) diyerek örneğe kusursuz zemin hazırlar.
options: A) Actually, when I'm in a bad mood, I find it more beneficial to think about a prosperous future rather than the better past.
B) Most people believe that looking at old photos showing the good times in the past has a positive influence on mood.
C) I don't agree. Recalling better times when a person is depressed will worsen their problems rather than solve them.
D) I don't think so. Instead of being nostalgic to feel happy, I generally try to find possible ways to overcome my crisis.
E) In such situations, seeking professional help or receiving support from close friends may bring a deep relief.

questions.questionText: 67. Edward: What do you think the difference between the words 'inequality' and 'disparity' is? William: Well, both have negative connotations. And they both imply a lack of something. I guess they are basically synonyms. Edward: ---- William: Oh, I see. So, if I say that there is a disparity between you and me, it might not be a bad thing, but inequality would be negative.
questions.explanation: William'in son cevabında 'Yani aramızda bir 'disparity' var dersem bu kötü bir şey olmayabilir, ama 'inequality' negatif olur' dediği için Edward'ın ikisi arasındaki farkı açıklaması gerekir. E şıkkındaki 'Haklısın, birbirlerine çok benziyorlar ama 'disparity' genelde yaş veya sayı farklılıklarından bahsetmek için kullanılırken 'inequality' bir adalet eksikliğini ifade eder' cümlesi bu mantığı sağlar.
options: A) That's sort of correct, but we use 'disparity' when we talk about scientific topics and 'inequality' for social issues.
B) That's basically correct, though 'disparity' tells us that something is unfair, while 'inequality' means some groups have more advantages than others.
C) They're more or less the same, but in academic circles, the term 'disparity' is an out-of-date expression; the current term is 'inequality'.
D) They're essentially synonymous, but we can use 'inequality' to express minor differences and 'disparity' for significant levels of difference.
E) You're right, they're very similar, but 'disparity' is generally used to talk about differences in age or number, whereas 'inequality' suggests a lack of fairness.

questions.questionText: 68. Exercise both strengthens our muscles and encourages the production of special chemicals called endorphins, which make us feel good and act to reduce pain.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'Egzersiz hem kaslarımızı güçlendirir hem de bizi iyi hissettiren ve ağrıyı azaltmaya yarayan endorfin adlı özel kimyasalların üretimini teşvik eder.' anlamındadır. A şıkkı 'Egzersiz yaparak daha güçlü kaslara sahip olmanın yanı sıra (In addition to having stronger muscles), egzersizin aktive ettiği endorfin adlı özel kimyasallar sayesinde daha iyi bir ruh halinde oluruz ve daha az acı hissederiz (feel less pain)' diyerek anlamı birebir korur.
options: A) In addition to having stronger muscles through exercising, we are in a better mood and feel less pain thanks to special chemicals, endorphins, that it activates.
B) In order for our muscles to be stronger, we should exercise, which helps us feel better and decreases pain by producing special chemicals called endorphins.
C) The special chemicals, endorphins, which are produced by our bodies when we exercise, strengthen our muscles as well as making us feel good and reducing pain.
D) Exercising makes us feel better and decreases pain because it strengthens our muscles and produces special chemicals called endorphins.
E) When we exercise, we feel good and experience less pain, and our bodies produce endorphins, which strengthen our muscles.

questions.questionText: 69. Chameleons cannot generate their own body heat so when they want to warm themselves, their colour will darken to absorb more heat from the sun.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'Bukelemunlar kendi vücut ısılarını üretemezler, bu yüzden ısınmak istediklerinde güneşten daha fazla ısı emmek için renkleri koyulaşır.' demektedir. D şıkkı 'Bukelemunlar kendi vücut ısılarını sağlayamadıkları için (Because... are not capable of), güneşten daha fazla ısı alınması ve ısınabilmeleri için renkleri koyulaşır' diyerek aynı fikri aktarır.
options: A) Once their colours darken, chameleons can get more heat from the sun, but to warm themselves much better, they have to produce their own body heat.
B) When chameleons transform themselves into a dark colour, they take in more heat from the sun and warm themselves easily, which helps them control their own body heat.
C) Chameleons can warm themselves with the heat from the sun thanks to the dark colours they change into, and that is why they do not need to generate their own body heat.
D) Because chameleons are not capable of providing their own body heat, their colour gets darker so that more heat is received from the sun, and they can warm themselves.
E) Chameleons' body heat is linked to dark colours because when they are darker, more heat from the sun can be absorbed, otherwise they cannot warm themselves.

questions.questionText: 70. Rome expanded from a small Italian city-state to a world power not just by conquering other societies but also by assimilating them.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'Roma, küçük bir İtalyan şehir devletinden dünya gücüne sadece diğer toplumları fethederek değil aynı zamanda onları asimile ederek genişledi.' demektedir. A şıkkı 'Başlangıçta küçük bir İtalyan şehir devleti olan Roma (Rome, which was initially...), diğer toplumları hem asimile ederek hem de fethederek bir dünya gücüne dönüştü (evolved into a world power by both...)' diyerek yapıyı 'not just... but also' dan 'both... and' formatına çevirip aynı anlamı vermektedir.
options: A) Rome, which was initially a small Italian city-state, evolved into a world power by both assimilating and conquering other societies.
B) Rome could not have developed into a world power from a small Italian city-state if it had not been able to conquer other societies and assimilate them.
C) What led Rome to expand into a world power from a small Italian city-state was the fact that it assimilated other societies rather than conquering them.
D) Having expanded into a world power, Rome was no longer a small Italian city-state as it managed to conquer and assimilate other societies.
E) Conquering other societies and assimilating them at the very beginning helped Rome to be a small Italian city-state and then a world power.

questions.questionText: 71. English is a mother tongue for many people in the world, who are increasingly outnumbered by those who learn English as a foreign language.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'İngilizce dünyadaki pek çok insanın anadilidir, ki onların sayısı İngilizceyi yabancı dil olarak öğrenenler tarafından giderek geride bırakılmaktadır (outnumbered)' şeklindedir. C şıkkı 'Dünya çapında birçok insanın anadili İngilizcedir; ancak, İngilizceyi yabancı dil olarak öğrenenlerin sayısı anadili İngilizce olanların sayısını çoktan geride bırakmıştır (surpassed)' diyerek eşdeğer bir anlama ulaşır.
options: A) English, either the mother tongue or foreign language of many people, is being spoken in almost every part of the world.
B) Although English is being learnt as a foreign language more widely than ever, there are also a large amount of people whose first language is English.
C) Lots of people around the world are native speakers of English; however, the number of learners of English as a foreign language has far surpassed the number of its native speakers.
D) Throughout the world, there is a significant gap between people who speak English as their first language and those who learn it as a foreign language.
E) In the past, the number of English native speakers was greater than those who had been learning English as a foreign language, but now it is not the case.

questions.questionText: 72. Almost all of us experience prejudice in one form or another. People make assumptions about us on the basis of our age, ethnicity, race or sex, and we often find ourselves automatically making the same sorts of assumptions about others. Herein lies a paradox: prejudice is socially undesirable; however, it is widespread in society. ---- For example, the system of apartheid in South Africa, where black people were forced to live away from white people, was a classic case of such prejudice, as it was defended publicly as being recognition of and respect for cultural differences.
questions.explanation: Önyargının toplumsal olarak istenmeyen ama yaygın bir şey olması (paradox) veriliyor. Daha sonra Güney Afrika'daki 'apartheid' rejiminden örnek (For example) verilip bunun kültürel farklılıklara saygı adı altında halka açık savunulduğu söyleniyor. D şıkkındaki 'Önyargının kurumsallaştığı (institutionalised) toplumlarda bile, varlığını mazeret göstermek veya inkar etmek için genellikle karmaşık gerekçelendirmeler (justifications) kullanılır' ifadesi apartheid örneğinin temel nedenini bağlar.
options: A) No matter what the majority thinks, the government has to make sure that all citizens are safe regardless of their background.
B) If public awareness is raised, prejudice may not trigger serious problems in multicultural societies.
C) Once the influence of certain ideologies becomes commonplace throughout the world, it is not easy to eradicate the core beliefs.
D) Even in societies where prejudice is institutionalised, sophisticated justifications are often used to excuse or deny its presence.
E) Only when the necessary precautions are taken, can people feel secure, respected and equal in society.

questions.questionText: 73. When someone we regard as a cherished friend suddenly is not there for us, it can feel like a hurtful betrayal. But before accusing or condemning them, you might want to ask yourself such questions as "Have they disappointed me before?", "Are my expectations too high?", "Have I always behaved perfectly towards them?". ---- Since we are all fallible and could potentially disappoint our friends, it is good to remember that there are two sides to every story.
questions.explanation: Kişinin birini kınamadan önce kendine bazı özeleştirel sorular ('Beklentilerim mi çok yüksek?' vb.) sorması gerektiği söyleniyor. Sonrasında 'Hepimiz yanılabileceğimiz için her hikayenin iki tarafı olduğunu hatırlamak iyidir' (there are two sides to every story) deniyor. A şıkkındaki 'Bu konuları dürüstçe incelemek/sorgulamak kendi sorumluluk payınızı (your share of responsibility) kabul etmenizi sağlayacaktır' ifadesi bu öz sorgulama ile empati arası geçişi mükemmel sağlar.
options: A) Exploring these issues honestly will allow you to accept your share of responsibility.
B) It is common in these situations to start wondering if the person was ever a 'real' friend.
C) Particularly with social media, many bestow the status of friend on others with surprising speed and ease.
D) An enduring friendship is based on a similar life experience, and a shared value system.
E) One reason for ending the friendship or distancing yourself from it is growing apart in terms of interests.

questions.questionText: 74. The origins of the 35 mm camera lie in the increasing availability of motion picture film stock during the early years of the 20th century. The 35 mm format was first used in Edison's Kinetoscope, a moving picture viewing device patented in 1891, and was later adopted as the standard film gauge by cinema-makers after 1896. ---- However, as the quality of the film improved, the potential virtues of small size and convenience of handling began to appeal to still camera designers.
questions.explanation: Boşluktan sonra 'Ancak (However), film kalitesi arttıkça küçük boyut ve taşıma kolaylığının potansiyel erdemleri fotoğraf makinesi tasarımcılarına cazip gelmeye başladı' deniyor. Buradaki 'However' geçişi için öncesinde filmin fotoğraf (still photography) için uygun görülmediğini belirten D şıkkı (İlk başlarda, boyutu küçük ve görüntü kalitesi düşük olduğundan fotoğrafçılık için ideal görülmedi) şarttır.
options: A) Three Spanish inventors took out a British patent for a still camera as early as 1908.
B) Since then, 35 mm has been recognised as the standard gauge for all professional motion pictures.
C) 35 mm motion picture film is a strip of plastic approximately 35 mm wide with perforations on both edges.
D) At first, the film was not considered ideal for still photography because of its relatively small size and poor image quality.
E) A further development in 35 mm camera took place when the USA started manufacturing 35 mm cameras in 1913.

questions.questionText: 75. Children who do not master basic reading skills at an early age, specifically the ability to automatically decode new words and build vocabulary that leads to fluency, experience academic failure. ---- In other words, the curriculum focuses much less on teaching students to acquire the basic tools of literacy, and much more on using those tools to learn content, express ideas, and solve problems. At this point, students are likely to be given content textbooks in science and social studies and to read nonfiction for the purpose of gaining information.
questions.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki cümlede 'Başka bir deyişle (In other words), müfredat temel araçları öğretmekten çok bu araçları içerik öğrenmek için kullanmaya odaklanır' denmektedir. Bu da okumanın artık bir 'araç' haline dönüştüğünü gösterir. C şıkkındaki 'Üçüncü sınıfa gelindiğinde, okumayı öğrenmek (learning to read) öğrenmek için okumaya (reading to learn) dönüşür' cümlesi bu bağlamı en açık şekilde sağlar.
options: A) The readiness of children to read, in particular, has recently gained greater attention from educators.
B) Family environment is as important as the school environment in children's development.
C) By the third grade, learning to read has become reading to learn.
D) Children with good phonological awareness skills usually learn to read quickly.
E) They also need to learn book-handling skills such as orienting a book correctly.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) As evidence has mounted about the threats that the Earth is facing, from rising temperatures and ocean acidification to deforestation and extreme weather, NASA has given priority to missions aimed at coping with the impacts. (II) NASA will be devising new technology to monitor earthquake-prone regions on the Earth via the satellites. (III) One of its newest satellites a $916 million observatory called SMAP (for Soil Moisture Active Passive) was launched in January 2015. (IV) It was designed to measure soil moisture both by bouncing a radar beam off the surface and by recording radiation emitted by the soil itself. (V) In July 2015, the active radar stopped transmitting, but the passive radiometer is still doing its job, and its maps will help scientists forecast droughts, floods, and famines.
questions.explanation: I, III, IV ve V numaralı cümleler NASA'nın Dünya'daki iklim/hava tehditleriyle (kuraklık, sel, nem vs.) başa çıkmak için geliştirdiği toprak nemi uydusuna (SMAP) odaklanır. Ancak (II) numaralı cümle, uyduların 'depreme eğilimli (earthquake-prone) bölgeleri izlemek' için teknoloji geliştirmesinden bahsederek iklim ve hava koşullarını kapsayan ana konudan sapar.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) During the Renaissance, Italy was not a single, unified country. (II) It consisted of a patchwork of small states, each with its own history, government, and traditions. (III) Artistic styles varied significantly from region to region. (IV) The writings of Vasari, a painter and architect from Florence, helped establish the idea that Renaissance art originated in Italy. (V) Although Florence, Rome, and Venice were the main centres of artistic activity, skilled artists produced significant works in other areas as well.
questions.explanation: Paragraf Rönesans döneminde İtalya'nın birleşik bir ülke olmaması (I, II), sanatsal tarzların bölgeden bölgeye değişmesi (III) ve bu bölgelerin başlıca merkezleri (Floransa, Roma, Venedik) (V) üzerinden coğrafi/sanatsal çeşitlilik temasını işler. (IV) numaralı cümle ise 'Vasari'nin yazıları Rönesans sanatının İtalya'da ortaya çıktığı fikrini pekiştirdi' diyerek bir ismin ideolojik/tarihi katkısına geçerek bölgesel çeşitlilik bağlamını koparır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) When we listen to music, electrical waves in our brains synchronise to the tempo, but some people's brains are better at synchronising to the beat. (II) Keith Doelling at New York University and his team recorded brainwaves of musicians and non-musicians as they listened to music. (III) While both groups could synchronise their brain waves to the rhythms, non-musicians struggled to synchronise to particularly slow music. (IV) Musical training might also help people with dyslexia - a difficulty with reading and writing caused by the brain's inability to see the difference between some letter shapes. (V) Musicians can do this, not because of their natural talent, but because they have been trained to mentally subdivide music into shorter sections.
questions.explanation: I, II, III ve V numaralı cümleler beyin dalgalarının müziğin temposuyla (ritmiyle) senkronize olması, müzisyenlerle müzisyen olmayanlar arasındaki farkı ve bunun nedenlerini (eğitim) inceler. Ancak (IV) numaralı cümlede müzik eğitiminin okuma-yazma güçlüğü olan 'disleksi' (dyslexia) hastalarına nasıl yardımcı olabileceği anlatılarak ritim/tempo senkronizasyonundan tamamen farklı bir konuya atlanmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 79. (I) While urbanisation has been a notable characteristic of European society for centuries, the trend toward industralisation and urbanisation has accelerated phenomenally since World War II. (II) London and Paris, for example, have been major urban centres for centuries, but many other European cities have experienced rapid expansion of their populations only since the late 1940s. (III) The clustering of substantial populations into metropolitan regions is a distinctive demographic feature of Europe. (IV) In countries such as Italy and Spain, which were largely agricultural and rural before World War II, we find that many of their cities have now become home to large numbers of people. (V) For example, Madrid and Rome experienced remarkable increases between 1960 and 1990, in comparison with more moderate increases for most cities in the former West Germany, France, and the United Kingdom.
questions.explanation: Metin spesifik olarak 2. Dünya Savaşı 'sonrasında' (since World War II) yaşanan hızlı kentleşme ve sanayileşmeyi, İngiltere, Fransa (II) ile İtalya ve İspanya (IV, V) gibi farklı Avrupa ülkelerini karşılaştırarak incelemektedir. (III) numaralı 'büyük nüfusların metropollerde toplanması Avrupa'nın demografik bir özelliğidir' genel ve zamansız yargısı, bu savaş sonrası dinamik ve kronolojik anlatım akışını böler.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 80. (I) Although iron is the most common metal, it was the last to be used by people. (II) Humanity made a huge advance when people learned how to use metals. (III) Metal tools were easier to shape than stone ones, and could be mass-produced using molds. (IV) Unlike a stone axe, which was useless when broken, a copper or bronze one could be melted down and recycled. (V) Shiny metals, such as gold and silver, were also perfect materials for jewellery and coins.
questions.explanation: II, III, IV ve V numaralı cümleler, insanlığın metal kullanmayı öğrenmesinin (taş aletlere kıyasla) sağladığı büyük ilerlemeleri (kolay şekil alma, geri dönüştürülebilme, takı/madeni para yapımı gibi genel avantajlar) anlatmaktadır. (I) numaralı cümle ise 'demirin en yaygın metal olmasına rağmen insanlar tarafından en son kullanıldığı' şeklindeki çok dar ve spesifik bilgisiyle bu genel metin çerçevesine uymamaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
